thread.title: Call buyers bet on Apple

author: InvestorsObserver
title: Call buyers bet on Apple
text:
Shutterstock photo Traders are buying OUt-of-the-money calls Wednesday on Apple ( AAPL ). So far, 2,108 contracts of the Nov. 290 call have changed hands, against open interest of 694 contracts. Today's trading has tracked the high side of the bid-ask spread, indicating these new contracts are being bought to open. InvestorsKeyhole Trade Alert IK-> The technicals for AAPL ($232.67 up $3.56) are bullish with an upward trend. The stock has support around $220. Look at the Nov. 195/200 bull-put spread for a 22-cent credit. That's a 4.6% return and the stock has to fall by 14.0% to cause a problem. [InvestorsKeyhole, various news and data services]
